raw_text: Asian Paints Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'This is to inform you that a meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on Thursday, 29th October 2026, inter alia, to consider the declaration of interim dividend, if any, for the financial year ending 31st March 2027.
